status_at_freeze: Specified before downloading or scoring this dataset in SupplySense; not externally preregistered
question: When does better forecast accuracy lead to better inventory decisions across demand intermittency, shared budgets, lead times and shortage-cost conditions?
dataset: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI 10.24432/C5BW33. CC BY 4.0
preprocessing: UK transactions only; positive quantity and unit price; exclude cancellation invoices and non-product codes (require five digits optionally followed by letters); drop exact duplicate rows in used transaction columns; sum quantities by product/date; omit customer IDs and descriptions; reindex absent product-days to zero, an assumed recorded-sales proxy
selection: 90 products with >=10 nonzero days and first sale in first 60 days through selection_end, sorted by SHA256('42:'+StockCode); no selection using future activity
model_parameters: Weekly seasonal repeat; last-28-day mean; SBA alpha=0.1 initialized at first positive demand; one pooled direct LightGBM Poisson model with 120 trees, 15 leaves, learning_rate=0.05, min_child_samples=30, random_state=42, n_jobs=2. No parameter search.
features: Series index; horizon; target weekday; origin-known last value, lag7, lag28, rolling means7/28/56, zero fraction28. Historical training origin has full 56-day history and all 28 labels <= selection_end. No future observed demand or prices in features.
selection_rule: Freeze weights at selection_end; choose display champion by pooled validation MAE, ties by model name. All four methods are reported at both test origins. No tuning after test inspection.
intervals: Per-model/per-series absolute-residual radius from 56 calibration predictions, order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.90), nonnegative clipped lower bounds. Empirical marginal coverage and mean width only; temporal dependence prevents a distribution-free guarantee.
intermittency: Training-only ADI = observed days/nonzero days; ADI >1.32 versus <=1.32. Report CV-squared of positive sizes as descriptive, not a model-selection rule. No causal claim about groups.

inventory.budget_reference: 28 * summed selection-period mean daily sales * unit_cost; freeze before test; budget includes order fees
inventory.policy: Existing fixed-origin lost-sales simulator; reset stock/budget each origin; shared budget; largest shortfall first then ID; exclude initial stock cost; no salvage

analysis: 27 assumptions x4 models x2 test origins =216 simulations. Report each origin and training-defined intermittency group using traces from the same full-population simulation; group budgets are not reset. Compare errors, costs, fill, lost units and components against seasonal naive. Retain every negative result.
uncertainty: 2000 paired product-cluster bootstrap replicates for pooled two-origin MAE differences versus seasonal naive, seed42, resampling entire product paths. These conditional intervals retain within-product temporal dependence but not cross-product dependence. For shared-budget simulation use observed two-origin ranges, not invalid independent-series confidence intervals; no significance claims.
limits: Single online retailer; wholesale and exceptional transactions; zeros may reflect closure or unavailability; positive-sales proxy excludes returns; two final origins insufficient for broad generalization; no real costs, savings, causal impact or novelty. No data beyond final date used. Public release contains aggregated selected series only, not invoices or customers.
